courses.subject: LGLA
courses.title: Elementary Lingala I
courses.description: Introduces the essential elements of Lingala structure and vocabulary and aspects of African cultures. Aural comprehension, reading, speaking, and writing are stressed.

courses.subject: LGLA
courses.title: Elementary Lingala II
courses.description: Continues the introduction of the essential elements of Lingala structure and vocabulary and aspects of African cultures. Aural comprehension, reading, speaking, and writing are stressed.

courses.subject: LGLA
courses.title: Intermediate Lingala III
courses.description: This courses increases language learning ability, communicative proficiency, and proficiency in the cultures of the Lingala-speaking people.

courses.subject: LGLA
courses.title: Intermediate Lingala IV
courses.description: This course reinforces language learning ability, communicative proficiency in the culture of the Lingala-speaking people through gradual exposure to more challenging tasks, with emphasis on poetry and prose reading, and creative writing.
